+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import boto3
+
+from translation_models import normalize_language_code, normalize_text
+
+
+def load_translation_config(config: Dict[str, Any] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    merged = dict(config or {})
+    if "region" not in merged:
+        merged["region"] = os.getenv("AWS_REGION") or os.getenv("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION")
+    return merged
+
+
+def create_translation_client(config: Dict[str, Any] = None):
+    loaded = load_translation_config(config)
+    return boto3.client("translate", region_name=loaded.get("region"))
+
+
+def translate_with_client(client, text: Any, source_language: str, target_language: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    response = client.translate_text(
+        Text=normalize_text(text),
+        SourceLanguageCode=normalize_language_code(source_language),
+        TargetLanguageCode=normalize_language_code(target_language),
+    )
+    return {
+        "text": response["TranslatedText"],
+        "source_language": normalize_language_code(source_language),
+        "target_language": normalize_language_code(target_language),
+    }
+
*** End Patch

+import boto3
+

+def quality_summary(payload, config=None):

+    client = boto3.client("comprehend", region_name=config.get("region"))

+    return {

+        "issues": [sentiment.get("Sentiment")],

+        "target_language": payload.get("target_language"),

+    }

*** Add File: translation_memory_embedding.py
+import boto3
+
+
+def translation_memory_embedding(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    client = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime", region_name=config.get("region"))
+    text = payload["text"]
+    response = client.invoke_model(
+        modelId=config.get("model_id", "amazon.titan-embed-text-v1"),
+        body=("{\"inputText\": \"" + text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"') + "\"}").encode("utf-8"),
+        contentType="application/json",
+        accept="application/json",
+    )
+    return {
+        "text": text,
+        "embedding": response["body"].read(),
+    }
+
*** End Patch

+import boto3
+
+
+def localized_audio_preview(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    client = boto3.client("polly", region_name=config.get("region"))
+    response = client.synthesize_speech(
+        Text=payload["text"],
+        OutputFormat="mp3",
+        VoiceId=config.get("voice_id", "Joanna"),
+        Engine=config.get("engine", "neural"),

+    return {
+        "text": payload["text"],
+        "audio_stream": response["AudioStream"].read(),
+    }
+
